WAIVER CLAIM (Nov 11 (4 days ago)): Fronge added Austin Ekeler (RB, WAS) for $5 FAAB.

WEEK 9 RESULTS: Ryan def. Corbishley, 115.7-90.9; Wingard def. Adam, 108.5-72.8; Kevin def. Drew, 104.2-47.4 (BLOWOUT); Fronge def. Charles, 137.6-133.7 (NAIL-BITER); Brent def. Jake, 165.5-113.3 (BLOWOUT); Mitchum def. Shaq, 153.9-138.5

tweets.name: Marty Volkman
tweets.text: BREAKING: Adam leads Fronge 117.8-110.3 with games still live. Helix is 4-14 on the season. If this holds, it is the biggest upset of the week and complicates the entire bottom of the playoff race.

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: WINGARD IS BEATING CORBISHLEY 79.7-60.9. I DO NOT CARE WHAT THE RECORDS SAY. APEX AT $125.49 AND DROPPING, SDR AT $59.14 AND CLIMBING, AND THE SCOREBOARD IS DOING EXACTLY WHAT IT SHOULD BE DOING RIGHT NOW.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, Corbishley was the most expensive loss of the week — both results, 90 points against Ryan, and now Wingard is up nearly twenty on him with games still going. That running back room is not a soft spot anymore. It is a structural collapse.

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: I had Corbishley third this week and noted the backfield grades twelfth in the league — and right now Wingard is proving every word of it. My rankings are not punditry. They are the receipts.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: 8-4 on the season, Wingard-Apex was the game I told you to watch, and I want a segment on what a Corbishley loss does to the second seed — because Kevin is 13-5 and that tiebreaker conversation just got a lot louder.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: I called Helix as the turnaround story of the offseason at +34.9% and right now Adam is leading Fronge by seven with the game still live. The model is not broken. The model was early.

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Shaq cut Lan Larison today — the same Lan Larison he claimed off waivers two days ago — and his live score against Brent is 71.1-69.4. The RB hole is not unaddressed. The RB hole is now a revolving door.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: 5-7 on the year and I had Wingard this week. Let the record reflect that.

tweets.name: Chad Bellwether
tweets.text: Terrence you had Wingard because you flip a coin and it landed right once. 7-5 on the season, two locks correct, and I am not taking moral victories from a man who is statistically worse than chance.

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: Charles is up 153.3-123.5 on Jake, Fronge added Brevyn Spann-Ford out of Dallas today and is in a dogfight with Adam, and the Ledger's Week 10 edition is going to have more moving parts than any issue we have published. Stay close.
